exposure: Introduction of a low-cost uterine balloon tamponade (ESM-UBT) device
outcome: Invasive procedures for PPH control (artery ligation, uterine compression sutures, or hysterectomy)
Composite outcome of PPH-related maternal death and/or invasive procedures
cohort: The study included 214,123 deliveries from women in nine intervention facilities and two control facilities in India.
finding: The introduction of the ESM-UBT device in intervention facilities in India was associated with a significant reduction in the rate of PPH-related maternal death and/or invasive procedures for PPH control compared to control facilities.
cross-section timing: Before and after the introduction of the ESM-UBT device.
